parameters.name: EffectiveTime
parameters.description:
The time when you want to perform the conversion. Valid values:

*   **Immediately**: immediately performs the conversion.
*   **MaintainTime** (default): performs the conversion during the maintenance window.

>  You can call the [ModifyInstanceMaintainTime](~~473775~~) operation to modify the maintenance window of an instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group.

>  You do not need to specify system parameters.

parameters.name: SeedSubInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the existing instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore create-global-distribute-cache --seed-sub-instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --resource-group-id - --effective-time Immediately --region cn-hangzhou
